entries.topic: Lobbying, elections and the money by country (Nov 2026)

claims.text: Keren Hayesod income 1 Apr 1921-31 Dec 1929: $20,121,980; US $10,976,970; South Africa $1,505,320; Germany $982,505; Romania $877,645; Great Britain $875,275; Poland $820,550; Canada $737,070.

Fabregat (Uruguay) and García Granados (Guatemala), both UNSCOP members, rallied the Latin American ambassadors into a bloc for partition at Eban's request; the plan 'might not have passed' without it.
Latin American votes on Resolution 181: 13 for, Cuba against, six abstentions (Argentina, Chile, Colombia, El Salvador, Honduras, Mexico).
March 1948: Dewey Stone and Frank Goldman telephoned Eddie Jacobson to ask him to see Truman.
Feinberg financed Truman's 1948 train tour; Truman believed Feinberg made his election possible (Davidson).
